violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion of Children (26 TAC §744.501(8))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion of Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Operational Policies did not state their policy for suspension and expulsion of children.

finding_variants.text: Operational Policies did not state their policy for suspension and expulsion of children.

Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operational policy states they follow Katy ISD guidelines. However, the operational policy does not identify or include what those guidelines are.
